t: This is Oval tube station, in the London Borough of Lambeth, on the Morden branch of the Northern line between Kennington and Stockwell. It's in fare zone 2. It opened on 18 December 1890 as part of the City and South London Railway. It's named after The Oval, the cricket ground and home of Surrey County Cricket Club, which it serves. The musician Harry Berly, who played violin, viola, saxophone and clarinet with British dance bands, died here in 1937.
